title: The canyon is younger than its rocks

scenes.say: This canyon is a mile deep. But the river that carved it is young.
scenes.visual: Sunrise over the rim, camera pushing in. 'A mile deep' lands on @deep; 'young' stamps on @young.

scenes.say: The Colorado started cutting here only five to six million years ago.
scenes.visual: Rapids in the inner gorge, push in. Big '5–6' pops on @five, 'million years' below.

scenes.say: Every layer it sliced through is a page of much older history.
scenes.visual: Layered buttes, slow orbit. Headline accent on @page.

scenes.say: These corals grew in a tropical sea, 340 million years ago.
scenes.visual: Fossil corals, gentle float. Counter to 340 on @340. Source kicker: Redwall Limestone.

scenes.say: And at the very bottom, the rock is 1.8 billion years old.
scenes.visual: Wide view down into the canyon, pan. Counter 1.8 on @1.8, 'billion years'.

scenes.say: Some mornings, the whole thing fills with cloud.
scenes.visual: Cloud inversion, camera rises. Accent on @cloud.

scenes.say: Two hundred seventy-seven miles of Earth's diary, open to anyone.
scenes.visual: End card: '277 miles of Earth's diary'. Photo credit chip.
